decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with strong strategic fit to flexible premium workplace interiors and visible standalone presentation, it is likely meeting or close enough to aspiration levels to justify continued support.

The chair family is close to the core offer, benefits from the firm's design and craftsmanship strengths, and there is no clear sign of performance shortfall that would trigger withdrawal after only one year.

Although somewhat niche, the floor cushions extend the firm's interior-solution logic and, given available organizational slack and limited time in market, management would give it more time before judging it below aspiration.
Despite lower website prominence, the upholstered sofa is close to the established business, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it absent stronger evidence of underperformance.
The high standing table fits the trend toward adaptable residential and workplace settings and aligns closely with the firm's existing capabilities, making continuation the likely choice.

Even though the rug collection is more distant from the core furniture offer, it complements a broader premium interior strategy and, with hiring and ongoing R&D indicating slack, management would likely continue it while results remain uncertain.
